IVE face backlash over ₩66,000 exhibition tickets and kuji’s 0.03988% top prize odds

By Shining Awards09/09/2026KPOP NEWS

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:38
Instaread

IVE are facing backlash over ₩66,000 exhibition tickets and a kuji event with a 0.03988% top prize chance.

Advertisement
Ads by PubFuture

Members Jang Wonyoung and An Yujin have been holding the An-Young: An Yujin x Jang Wonyoung Media Exhibition from September 5th to 27th.

Fans have criticized the exhibition’s ₩66,000 KRW (about $49.20 USD) ticket price and complained about a lack of photos featuring both An Yujin and Jang Wonyoung together.

Fans also questioned a new IVE-centered “kuji” event, asking whether attendees “have to pay to be called by name” and whether anyone had actually won.

“We have to pay to be called by name? Has anyone actually won anything?”

“Kuji” is a Japanese-style random draw lottery for figures and merchandise, with prizes varying by ticket grade. The kuji event was jointly held by Starship Entertainment and Mnet Plus from the 7th to the 11th.

Each draw cost ₩7,500 KRW (about $5.60 USD). Prizes were split into grades A to F: Grade A included a “video calling your name,” Grade B a “hand-signed Polaroid,” Grade C a “hand-signed concert merchandise,” Grade D a “portrait film keyring,” Grade E a “unit photocards set,” and Grade F a “individual photocard,” all randomly drawn.

The chance of drawing an A prize was 0.03988%, which led to complaints from fans and from IVE’s official fan club, DIVE.

Fans reacted with multiple comments.
